title: HyperBuf edit location
description: The location pointed at with "Edit in editor": the result.location of get-location. See docs/dev/edit-location.md §5. The editor verifies the location with the information for verification given here (file, expect, context) before it moves.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to edit

range.description: Lines and columns start at 1. A column counts Unicode code points (Emacs characters). end does not include the character at that position

precision.description: block means that the position is ambiguous and only the whole block is certain

expect.description: The original Markdown text that should be in that range (newlines are LF). Only the beginning when it is long (expectTruncated)

context.description: The text just before and just after the range. The editor checks that the buffer text just before ends with before and the text just after starts with after

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content (bytes) of the file version that the viewer rendered

mtime.description: Likewise, the modification time (milliseconds since the epoch)

selection.description: The text selected in the viewer, exactly as displayed (empty if none)

readAt.description: The time when the viewer read the file (milliseconds since the epoch)

markedAt.description: The time when "Edit in editor" was chosen (milliseconds since the epoch)
